evals.expected_output: The plan's Execution says single agent. Records every clarification in plan.md before starting
Moves the folder to in-progress with plans.py
Records a baseline of failing tests before the first task
Implements the tasks itself without launching implementer or verifier subagents
Adds or updates tests for the changed behaviour

evals.prompt: Add a --dry-run flag to the export command that prints the files it would write without writing them.

expectations: States a short contract with change, files, out of scope and done-when checks before coding
Does not create a plan folder or ledger
Writes the test first and sees it fail before implementing the flag
Runs the full test suite and reports the result
Leaves the changes uncommitted

Suggests make-plan
Does not write code or improvise a design
